direction: Calm, operational Thai-language workspace for village staff. Prioritize record lookup, clear workflow status, and traceable actions over decorative UI.

patterns.actions: Blue primary, neutral secondary, restrained red destructive.
patterns.status: Text-labelled semantic badges; color is supplemental.
patterns.forms: Inline field validation; SweetAlert2 for consequential confirmation and outcomes.
patterns.data: Searchable compact tables on desktop; stacked readable records on mobile.
patterns.charts: Recharts with labelled units/date ranges and actionable record context.
